card.text: Explore Amalthea with Galileo imagery and its source-backed irregular shape.

introduction.text: Amalthea is Jupiter’s largest inner moon, an elongated, reddish world with giant craters and bright patches. Dust escaping its low-gravity surface helps form Jupiter’s faint gossamer ring.

normal.title: SSI mosaic
normal.summary: Surface brightness is adjusted to reduce photographed shading. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing or unreliable images.

elevation.title: Shape-derived radial height
elevation.summary: Height from a Voyager model, relative to an 83.5 km sphere. Unseen terrain and small features are uncertain.
